title: Measurement
brief: a thermometer, a survey, an interferometer and a headcount fill the same five fields
about: Stated as a conjecture: four instruments that share no physics fold the same way, because a measurement is a cell.
For each of them the five fields are named without strain, and the same five operations answer for all four.
No numbers are claimed here. What is claimed is that the table can be filled in every row, and a row that cannot be filled would end it.

table.origin: the instrument and whoever read it
